title: ViSAGe: A Global-Scale Analysis of Visual Stereotypes in Text-to-Image Generation
reasoning: The paper systematically evaluates the 'offensiveness' of generated images across different nationalities as a core part of its study. Furthermore, it includes 'religious' as a specific visual attribute/stereotype in its benchmarking dataset (ViSAGe) and evaluates how T2I models depict it.
